<?php
/**
 * Petshop Email Dispatch Layer
 *
 * Centrinis laisku siuntimo sluoksnis. Sender = TIK transportas.
 * Visa logika (kada, kam, ar galima, ka rodyti) gyvena CIA.
 *
 * Grandine:
 *   eventas -> enqueue() -> outbox (ps_email_jobs)
 *           -> cron -> eligibility gate -> render -> provider->send()
 *           -> status update + provider_message_id
 *
 * Principai (S180-B):
 *  - Verslo taisykles NE Sender viduje
 *  - Sablonu originalai musu repo
 *  - Idempotency per job_key (tas pats eventas nesiunciamas du kartus)
 *  - Srauto klasifikacija yra DUOMUO (FLOWS masyve), ne kodas
 *
 * @package petshop-core
 * @since 0.16.0 (S309, 2026-07-30)
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) { exit; }

class Petshop_Email_Dispatch {

	const DB_VERSION = '1.2.0';
	const OPT_DB_VER = 'petshop_email_dispatch_db';

	/** Kiek kartu atidedam, kol pripazistam galutinai nepavykusiu */
	const DEFER_RETRY_SECONDS = 86400; // +24 val.
	const MAX_DEFER_DAYS      = 14;

	/**
	 * SRAUTU REGISTRAS.
	 *
	 * class:
	 *   transactional — sutartinis/paties zmogaus inicijuotas. Consent NETIKRINAMAS.
	 *                   Stabdo tik hard bounce / istrintas kontaktas.
	 *   service       — su preke/paslauga susijes. Marketingo consent NEREIKIA,
	 *                   bet gerbiamas globalus atsisakymas (PS_TRANSACTIONAL_ONLY) ir suppression.
	 *   marketing     — reikalauja PS_MARKETING_CONSENT = true.
	 *
	 * Klasifikacija pagal TZ MASTER §4.4.4/§4.4.5 (uzrakinta 2026-07-06).
	 * Keiciant klase — keiciama TIK cia, kodo liesti nereikia.
	 */
	public static function flows() {
		$flows = array(
			// --- Sutartiniai / paties zmogaus inicijuoti ---
			'order_paid'              => array( 'class' => 'transactional', 'template' => 'order-paid',        'delay' => 0 ),
			'order_shipped'           => array( 'class' => 'transactional', 'template' => 'order-shipped',     'delay' => 0 ),
			'payment_failed'          => array( 'class' => 'transactional', 'template' => 'dunning-1',         'delay' => 0 ),
			'shipment_returned'       => array( 'class' => 'transactional', 'template' => 'shipment-returned', 'delay' => 0 ),
			'consent_changed'         => array( 'class' => 'transactional', 'template' => 'consent-changed',   'delay' => 0 ),
			'pet_reminder_due'        => array( 'class' => 'transactional', 'template' => 'pet-reminder',      'delay' => 0 ),
			'subscription_t5_notice'  => array( 'class' => 'transactional', 'template' => 'subscription-t5',   'delay' => 0 ),

			// --- Su preke susije (TZ §4.4.5: rodoma visiems, be marketingo consent) ---
			'refill_due'              => array( 'class' => 'service', 'template' => 'refill',            'delay' => 0 ),
			// S317: cart_abandoned = MARKETINGAS (privalomas consent).
			// Tai KEICIA uzrakinta TZ §4.4.5 — registruota kaip naujas sprendimas.
			// delay=0, nes 2 val. laukimas jau ivyko DETEKTORIUJE.
			'cart_abandoned'          => array( 'class' => 'marketing', 'template' => 'cart-abandoned-1',  'delay' => 0 ),
						// S324: delay=0 — 24 val. laukimas jau ivyko DETEKTORIUJE (detect_stage2).
			// Kitaip butu laukiama DVIGUBAI.
			'cart_abandoned_2'        => array( 'class' => 'marketing', 'template' => 'cart-abandoned-2',  'delay' => 0 ),
						// S326: delay=0 — 2 d. laukia DETEKTORIUS (nuo nekintancios `_ps_completed_at`),
			// ne dispatch eile. Kitaip butu laukiama dvigubai.
			'post_purchase_2d'        => array( 'class' => 'service', 'template' => 'post-purchase-2d',  'delay' => 0 ),
			'post_purchase_7d'        => array( 'class' => 'service', 'template' => 'post-purchase-7d',  'delay' => 604800 ),
			'post_purchase_14d'       => array( 'class' => 'service', 'template' => 'post-purchase-14d', 'delay' => 1209600 ),

			// --- Marketingas (reikia PS_MARKETING_CONSENT) ---
			'win_back_60'             => array( 'class' => 'marketing', 'template' => 'win-back-60',   'delay' => 0 ),
			'win_back_90'             => array( 'class' => 'marketing', 'template' => 'win-back-90',   'delay' => 0 ),
			'win_back_120'            => array( 'class' => 'marketing', 'template' => 'win-back-120',  'delay' => 0 ),
			'legacy_reactivation_l1'  => array( 'class' => 'marketing', 'template' => 'legacy-l1',     'delay' => 0 ),
			'founding_activation'     => array( 'class' => 'marketing', 'template' => 'founding',      'delay' => 0 ),
		);
		/**
		 * Leidzia keisti/prideti srautus be sio failo redagavimo.
		 */
		return apply_filters( 'petshop_email_flows', $flows );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Lentele                                                          */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	public static function table() {
		global $wpdb;
		return $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_email_jobs';
	}

	public static function install() {
		global $wpdb;
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php';
		$t = self::table();
		$charset = $wpdb->get_charset_collate();

		$sql = "CREATE TABLE $t (
			id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
			job_key VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
			flow VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
			flow_class VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'service',
			recipient_email VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
			recipient_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			subject VARCHAR(255) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			payload LONGTEXT NULL,
			status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
			block_reason VARCHAR(64) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			provider VARCHAR(32) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			provider_message_id VARCHAR(191) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			attempts SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
			last_error TEXT NULL,
			skip_reason VARCHAR(64) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			error_message TEXT NULL,
			decision_at DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			next_attempt_at DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			context_json LONGTEXT NULL,
			scheduled_at DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			sent_at DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
			updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (id),
			UNIQUE KEY job_key (job_key),
			KEY status_sched (status, scheduled_at),
			KEY status_next (status, next_attempt_at),
			KEY skip_idx (skip_reason),
			KEY flow_idx (flow),
			KEY recipient (recipient_email),
			KEY provider_msg (provider_message_id)
		) $charset;";

		dbDelta( $sql );
		update_option( self::OPT_DB_VER, self::DB_VERSION );
	}

	public static function maybe_install() {
		if ( get_option( self::OPT_DB_VER ) !== self::DB_VERSION ) {
			self::install();
		}
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Ieiga: enqueue                                                   */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * Ideda laiska i outbox. Idempotentiska pagal $job_key.
	 *
	 * @param string $flow     Srauto raktas is flows()
	 * @param string $email    Gavejas
	 * @param array  $payload  Duomenys sablonui
	 * @param array  $args     job_key, user_id, scheduled_at, subject
	 * @return array ok, job_id, duplicate, error
	 */
	public static function enqueue( $flow, $email, $payload = array(), $args = array() ) {
		global $wpdb;

		$flows = self::flows();
		if ( ! isset( $flows[ $flow ] ) ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'error' => 'unknown_flow: ' . $flow );
		}
		$email = sanitize_email( $email );
		if ( ! is_email( $email ) ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'error' => 'invalid_email' );
		}

		$cfg     = $flows[ $flow ];
		$job_key = isset( $args['job_key'] ) && $args['job_key'] !== ''
			? substr( (string) $args['job_key'], 0, 191 )
			: $flow . ':' . md5( $email . '|' . wp_json_encode( $payload ) );

		$existing = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT id FROM " . self::table() . " WHERE job_key = %s LIMIT 1", $job_key ) );
		if ( $existing ) {
			return array( 'ok' => true, 'job_id' => (int) $existing, 'duplicate' => true );
		}

		$delay = isset( $args['delay'] ) ? (int) $args['delay'] : (int) $cfg['delay'];
		$sched = isset( $args['scheduled_at'] ) && $args['scheduled_at']
			? $args['scheduled_at']
			: gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + $delay );

		$now = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		$ok = $wpdb->insert( self::table(), array(
			'job_key'           => $job_key,
			'flow'              => $flow,
			'flow_class'        => $cfg['class'],
			'recipient_email'   => $email,
			'recipient_user_id' => isset( $args['user_id'] ) ? (int) $args['user_id'] : null,
			'subject'           => isset( $args['subject'] ) ? substr( (string) $args['subject'], 0, 255 ) : null,
			'payload'           => wp_json_encode( $payload ),
			'status'            => 'pending',
			'context_json'      => isset( $args['context'] ) ? wp_json_encode( $args['context'] ) : null,
			'scheduled_at'      => $sched,
			'created_at'        => $now,
			'updated_at'        => $now,
		) );

		if ( ! $ok ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'error' => 'insert_failed: ' . $wpdb->last_error );
		}
		return array( 'ok' => true, 'job_id' => (int) $wpdb->insert_id, 'duplicate' => false );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Eligibility gate — VIENA vieta visoms taisyklems                 */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * @return array allowed(bool), reason(string)
	 */
	public static function check_eligibility( $flow_class, $email, $flow = '', $context = array() ) {

		// 0) Netinkamas gavejas
		if ( ! is_email( $email ) ) {
			return array( 'allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'invalid_recipient', 'terminal' => true );
		}

		// 1) KANALINIS suppression (S314).
		//    Sender turi du atskirus kanalus: email=marketingas, temail=transakciniai.
		//    Marketingo atsisakymas NEGALI blokuoti uzsakymo/refill/prenumeratos laisku.
		$channel = ( 'marketing' === $flow_class )
			? Petshop_Email_Suppression::CH_MARKETING
			: Petshop_Email_Suppression::CH_TRANSACTIONAL;

		if ( class_exists( 'Petshop_Email_Suppression' )
			&& Petshop_Email_Suppression::is_suppressed( $email, $channel ) ) {
			$why = Petshop_Email_Suppression::reason_for( $email, $channel );
			return array(
				'allowed'  => false,
				'reason'   => 'suppressed_' . $channel . ( $why ? '_' . $why : '' ),
				'terminal' => true,
			);
		}

		// 1b) Senas globalus sarasas (suderinamumui, kol bus perkeltas).
		if ( self::is_suppressed( $email ) ) {
			return array( 'allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'suppressed', 'terminal' => true );
		}

		// 2) Transakciniai toliau netikrinami — sutartinis pagrindas.
		if ( 'transactional' === $flow_class ) {
			return array( 'allowed' => true, 'reason' => '' );
		}

		// 3) Globalus "tik transakciniai" pasirinkimas — stabdo service ir marketing.
		if ( self::is_transactional_only( $email ) ) {
			return array( 'allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'transactional_only', 'terminal' => true );
		}

		// 4) Marketingui butinas aiskus sutikimas.
		if ( 'marketing' === $flow_class ) {
			// S321: BUTINAI per Contact_Policy::has_consent() — ps_get_marketing_consent()
			// grazina STRING, o (bool) 'false' === true. Tiesioginis castas praleisdavo
			// atsisakiusius zmones.
			$ok = class_exists( 'Petshop_Contact_Policy' )
				? Petshop_Contact_Policy::has_consent( $email )
				: false;
			if ( ! $ok ) {
				return array( 'allowed' => false, 'reason' => 'consent_missing', 'terminal' => true );
			}
		}

		// 5) Papildomos taisykles per filtra (pvz. stop-rule konkreciam srautui).
		// 5) Srauto specifines taisykles (registruoja pats srautas).
		//    Gali grazinti 'terminal' => false — tada sprendimas ATIDEDAMAS (deferred),
		//    o ne uzdaromas galutinai.
		$extra = apply_filters( 'petshop_email_eligibility',
			array( 'allowed' => true, 'reason' => '', 'terminal' => true ),
			$flow, $flow_class, $email, $context );

		return is_array( $extra ) ? $extra : array( 'allowed' => true, 'reason' => '' );
	}

	public static function is_suppressed( $email ) {
		$list = (array) get_option( 'petshop_email_suppression', array() );
		if ( in_array( strtolower( $email ), array_map( 'strtolower', $list ), true ) ) {
			return true;
		}
		return (bool) apply_filters( 'petshop_email_is_suppressed', false, $email );
	}

	public static function is_transactional_only( $email ) {
		$u = get_user_by( 'email', $email );
		if ( $u && get_user_meta( $u->ID, 'ps_transactional_only', true ) === 'yes' ) {
			return true;
		}
		return (bool) apply_filters( 'petshop_email_transactional_only', false, $email );
	}

	/**
	 * Prideda adresa i suppression sarasa (bounce, skundas, istrynimas).
	 */
	/**
	 * S314: suppression VISADA kanalinis. $channel privalomas.
	 * Be kanalo kviesti nebegalima — tai buvo klaidos saltinis
	 * (marketingo atsisakymas butu uzbloikaves transakcinius).
	 */
	public static function suppress( $email, $channel, $reason = 'manual', $source = 'local' ) {
		if ( ! class_exists( 'Petshop_Email_Suppression' ) ) { return false; }
		return Petshop_Email_Suppression::suppress( $email, $channel, $reason, $source );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Apdorojimas                                                      */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * Paima ir issiuncia laukiancius laiskus.
	 *
	 * @param int  $limit
	 * @param bool $dry_run Jei true — tik parodo, ka DARYTU, nieko nesiuncia.
	 */
	public static function process_pending( $limit = 20, $dry_run = false ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$now  = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT * FROM " . self::table() . "
			 WHERE ( status = 'pending' AND ( scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= %s ) )
			    OR ( status = 'deferred' AND next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at <= %s )
			 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT %d", $now, $now, (int) $limit ), ARRAY_A );

		$out = array( 'dry_run' => (bool) $dry_run, 'picked' => count( (array) $rows ), 'results' => array() );

		foreach ( (array) $rows as $r ) {
			$res = self::process_one( $r, $dry_run );
			$out['results'][] = $res;
		}
		return $out;
	}

	protected static function process_one( $row, $dry_run = false ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$id    = (int) $row['id'];
		$flow  = $row['flow'];
		$email = $row['recipient_email'];

		$context = json_decode( (string) $row['context_json'], true );
		if ( ! is_array( $context ) ) { $context = array(); }

		$elig = self::check_eligibility( $row['flow_class'], $email, $flow, $context );
		if ( ! $elig['allowed'] ) {
			$terminal = ! isset( $elig['terminal'] ) || $elig['terminal'];
			$now2     = current_time( 'mysql', true );

			// Atidejimo langas: po MAX_DEFER_DAYS atidėti nebeprasminga.
			if ( ! $terminal ) {
				$age_days = ( time() - strtotime( $row['created_at'] ) ) / 86400;
				if ( $age_days > self::MAX_DEFER_DAYS ) {
					$terminal = true;
					$elig['reason'] = 'deferral_expired';
				}
			}

			if ( ! $dry_run ) {
				$upd = array(
					'status'       => $terminal ? 'skipped' : 'deferred',
					'skip_reason'  => substr( (string) $elig['reason'], 0, 64 ),
					'block_reason' => substr( (string) $elig['reason'], 0, 64 ), // suderinamumui
					'decision_at'  => $now2,
					'updated_at'   => $now2,
				);
				if ( ! $terminal ) {
					$upd['next_attempt_at'] = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + self::DEFER_RETRY_SECONDS );
				}
				$wpdb->update( self::table(), $upd, array( 'id' => $id ) );
			}
			return array(
				'id' => $id, 'flow' => $flow,
				'action' => $terminal ? 'SKIPPED' : 'DEFERRED',
				'reason' => $elig['reason'],
			);
		}

		$payload = json_decode( (string) $row['payload'], true );
		if ( ! is_array( $payload ) ) { $payload = array(); }

		// S322: srautas gali paruosti papildoma konteksta (pvz. recovery tokena)
		// TIK PO sekmingos eligibility ir TIK VIENA KARTA — rezultatas issaugomas
		// context_json. Retry naudoja TA PATI konteksta, todel nesukuriami
		// keli galiojantys tokenai tam paciam krepseliui.
		$prepared = apply_filters( 'petshop_email_prepare_context', $context, $flow, $row );
		if ( is_array( $prepared ) && $prepared !== $context ) {
			$context = $prepared;
			if ( ! $dry_run ) {
				$wpdb->update( self::table(),
					array( 'context_json' => wp_json_encode( $context ), 'updated_at' => current_time( 'mysql', true ) ),
					array( 'id' => $id ) );
			}
		}
		// sablonas mato ir payload, ir paruosta konteksta
		$payload = array_merge( $payload, $context );

		$rendered = self::render( $flow, $payload, $row );
		if ( empty( $rendered['html'] ) ) {
			if ( ! $dry_run ) {
				$wpdb->update( self::table(), array(
					'status'        => 'failed',
					'last_error'    => 'template_missing: ' . $flow,
					'error_message' => 'template_missing: ' . $flow,
					'decision_at'   => current_time( 'mysql', true ),
					'updated_at'    => current_time( 'mysql', true ),
				), array( 'id' => $id ) );
			}
			return array( 'id' => $id, 'flow' => $flow, 'action' => 'FAILED', 'reason' => 'template_missing' );
		}

		if ( $dry_run ) {
			return array(
				'id' => $id, 'flow' => $flow, 'action' => 'WOULD_SEND',
				'to' => $email, 'subject' => $rendered['subject'],
				'html_len' => strlen( $rendered['html'] ),
			);
		}

		// Provider: pirma filtras (ateities SMS/kitas ESP), tada esama core konvencija.
		$provider = apply_filters( 'petshop_email_provider', null );
		if ( ! $provider && function_exists( 'ps_esp_adapter' ) ) {
			$provider = ps_esp_adapter();
		}
		if ( ! $provider || ! is_object( $provider ) || ! method_exists( $provider, 'send_transactional_email' ) ) {
			$wpdb->update( self::table(), array(
				'status'        => 'failed',
				'last_error'    => 'no_provider',
				'error_message' => 'no_provider',
				'attempts'      => (int) $row['attempts'] + 1,
				'decision_at'   => current_time( 'mysql', true ),
				'updated_at'    => current_time( 'mysql', true ),
			), array( 'id' => $id ) );
			return array( 'id' => $id, 'flow' => $flow, 'action' => 'FAILED', 'reason' => 'no_provider' );
		}

		$res = $provider->send_transactional_email(
			$email, $rendered['subject'], $rendered['html'],
			array( 'to_name' => isset( $payload['name'] ) ? $payload['name'] : '' )
		);

		$ok = ! empty( $res['ok'] );
		$wpdb->update( self::table(), array(
			'status'              => $ok ? 'sent' : ( ! empty( $res['should_retry'] ) ? 'pending' : 'failed' ),
			'provider'            => 'sender',
			'provider_message_id' => isset( $res['esp_message_id'] ) ? substr( (string) $res['esp_message_id'], 0, 191 ) : null,
			'subject'             => substr( $rendered['subject'], 0, 255 ),
			'attempts'            => (int) $row['attempts'] + 1,
			'last_error'          => $ok ? null : ( isset( $res['error'] ) ? substr( (string) $res['error'], 0, 500 ) : 'unknown' ),
			'error_message'       => $ok ? null : ( isset( $res['error'] ) ? substr( (string) $res['error'], 0, 500 ) : 'unknown' ),
			'decision_at'         => current_time( 'mysql', true ),
			'sent_at'             => $ok ? current_time( 'mysql', true ) : null,
			'updated_at'          => current_time( 'mysql', true ),
		), array( 'id' => $id ) );

		// S315: pranešam, kad kontaktas panaudotas. Politikos reikšmę skaičiuoja
		// Petshop_Contact_Policy, ne dispatch. Nesekme CIA NEGALI paversti
		// issiusto laisko failed — todel apgaubta ir rezultatas ignoruojamas.
		if ( $ok ) {
			try {
				do_action( 'petshop_contact_used', $email, $flow );
			} catch ( Exception $e ) {
				// tyliai — laiskas jau issiustas
			}
		}

		return array(
			'id' => $id, 'flow' => $flow, 'action' => $ok ? 'SENT' : 'FAILED',
			'msg_id' => isset( $res['esp_message_id'] ) ? $res['esp_message_id'] : '',
			'error'  => $ok ? '' : ( isset( $res['error'] ) ? $res['error'] : '' ),
		);
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Sablonai                                                         */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * Renderina sablona is repo (templates/emails/{slug}.php).
	 * Sablonas gauna $payload ir turi nustatyti $subject bei grazinti HTML.
	 */
	public static function render( $flow, $payload, $row = array() ) {
		$flows = self::flows();
		if ( ! isset( $flows[ $flow ] ) ) {
			return array( 'subject' => '', 'html' => '' );
		}
		$slug = $flows[ $flow ]['template'];
		$file = PETSHOP_CORE_DIR . 'templates/emails/' . $slug . '.php';

		$custom = apply_filters( 'petshop_email_template_path', $file, $flow, $slug );
		if ( ! file_exists( $custom ) ) {
			return array( 'subject' => '', 'html' => '' );
		}

		$subject    = '';
		$flow_class = isset( $row['flow_class'] ) ? $row['flow_class'] : 'service';
		$recipient  = isset( $row['recipient_email'] ) ? $row['recipient_email'] : '';
		ob_start();
		include $custom; // sablonas gali nustatyti $subject; mato $payload, $flow_class, $recipient
		$html = ob_get_clean();

		if ( $subject === '' && ! empty( $row['subject'] ) ) {
			$subject = $row['subject'];
		}
		return array( 'subject' => $subject, 'html' => $html );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Statistika / diagnostika                                         */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	public static function stats() {
		global $wpdb;
		$t = self::table();
		return array(
			'by_status' => $wpdb->get_results( "SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM $t GROUP BY status", ARRAY_A ),
			'by_flow'   => $wpdb->get_results( "SELECT flow, status, COUNT(*) c FROM $t GROUP BY flow, status", ARRAY_A ),
			'skipped'   => $wpdb->get_results( "SELECT skip_reason, COUNT(*) c FROM $t WHERE status IN ('skipped','deferred') GROUP BY skip_reason", ARRAY_A ),

				        SUM(status='skipped')  AS skipped,
				        SUM(status='deferred') AS deferred,

				        SUM(status='pending')  AS pending

		);
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Cron                                                             */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'ps_email_dispatch_cron', array( __CLASS__, 'cron_run' ) );

			wp_schedule_event( time() + 120, 'ps_esp_5min', 'ps_email_dispatch_cron' );
		}
	}

	public static function cron_run() {
		self::process_pending( 20, false );
	}
}

<?php
/**
 * Petshop Post-Purchase — S326 DETEKTORIUS.
 *
 * SAVININKO AUDITAS (2026-07-31): WooCommerce siuncia 11 laisku, bet VISI
 * apie uzsakymo BUSENA (naujas / apmoketa / issiusta / atsaukta / grazinta).
 * Po „issiusta" — tyla. Review/follow-up plugin'u NERA, cron'u NERA.
 * Post-purchase srautas savininko NETURI.
 *
 * ★ LAIKMACIO ZYMA — KRITINE ★
 * `+2 d.` skaiciuojama nuo NEKINTANCIOS zymos `_ps_completed_at`, o NE nuo
 * Woo `post_modified` ar dabartinio statuso keitimo laiko. Kitaip bet koks
 * velesnis uzsakymo redagavimas NUKELTU laikmati is naujo.
 *
 * Ta pati taisykle kaip S323 ciklo raktas: laikmatis negali remtis lauku,
 * kuri kiti veiksmai keicia.
 *
 * ISTORINIAI UZSAKYMAI: zyma dedama TIK nuo idiegimo momento, todel seni
 * uzsakymai i kandidatus NEPATENKA savaime — atskiro „seed" nereikia.
 *
 * @package petshop-core
 * @since 0.24.0 (S326, 2026-07-31)
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) { exit; }

class Petshop_Post_Purchase {

	const META_COMPLETED = '_ps_completed_at';
	const STAGE_2D       = 172800; // 2 d.
	const BATCH          = 50;

	/** Busenos, kurioms siuntimas NEBEPRASMINGAS */
	const DEAD_STATUSES = array( 'cancelled', 'refunded', 'failed', 'trash' );

	public static function init() {
		// Zyma dedama VIENA KARTA, pirma karta uzsakymui tapus completed.
		add_action( 'woocommerce_order_status_completed', array( __CLASS__, 'stamp' ), 10, 1 );
		add_action( 'ps_post_purchase_check', array( __CLASS__, 'cron_run' ) );
		if ( ! wp_next_scheduled( 'ps_post_purchase_check' ) ) {
			wp_schedule_event( time() + 600, 'hourly', 'ps_post_purchase_check' );
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Nekintanti zyma. Jei jau yra — NELIECIAM.
	 */
	public static function stamp( $order_id ) {
		$order = wc_get_order( $order_id );
		if ( ! $order ) { return; }
		if ( $order->get_meta( self::META_COMPLETED, true ) ) { return; }
		$order->update_meta_data( self::META_COMPLETED, gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' ) );
		$order->save();
	}

	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
	/* Detektorius                                                        */
	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

	/**
	 * @param bool $dry_run
	 */
	public static function detect_2d( $dry_run = false ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$cutoff = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - self::STAGE_2D );

		$out = array(
			'dry_run' => (bool) $dry_run, 'cutoff' => $cutoff,
			'candidates' => 0, 'queued' => 0, 'skipped' => array(), 'details' => array(),
		);

		$ids = self::find_stamped_before( $cutoff, self::BATCH );
		$out['candidates'] = count( $ids );

		foreach ( $ids as $order_id ) {
			$order = wc_get_order( $order_id );
			if ( ! $order ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $order_id, 'order_gone' );
				continue;
			}
			// Uzsakymas atsauktas / grazintas / nepavykes
			if ( in_array( $order->get_status(), self::DEAD_STATUSES, true ) ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $order_id, 'status_' . $order->get_status() );
				continue;
			}
			// Daline grazinimo suma taip pat rodo problema — nesiunciam „ar viskas gerai"
			if ( (float) $order->get_total_refunded() > 0 ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $order_id, 'refunded_partially' );
				continue;
			}
			$email = $order->get_billing_email();
			if ( ! $email || ! is_email( $email ) ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $order_id, 'no_email' );
				continue;
			}

			if ( $dry_run ) {
				$out['details'][] = array( 'order' => $order_id, 'action' => 'WOULD_QUEUE' );
				continue;
			}

			$items = array();
			foreach ( $order->get_items() as $it ) {
				$items[] = array(
					'name'     => $it->get_name(),
					'quantity' => (float) $it->get_quantity(),
				);
			}

			$res = Petshop_Email_Dispatch::enqueue(
				'post_purchase_2d',
				$email,
				array(
					'order_id'     => (int) $order_id,
					'order_number' => $order->get_order_number(),
					'first_name'   => $order->get_billing_first_name(),
					'items'        => $items,
					'order_url'    => $order->get_view_order_url(),
				),
				array(
					'job_key' => 'post_purchase_2d:' . $order_id,
					'user_id' => $order->get_customer_id() ? (int) $order->get_customer_id() : null,
					'context' => array( 'order_id' => (int) $order_id ),
				)
			);
			if ( ! empty( $res['ok'] ) && empty( $res['duplicate'] ) ) { $out['queued']++; }
			$out['details'][] = array( 'order' => $order_id, 'action' => 'QUEUED', 'items' => count( $items ) );
		}
		return $out;
	}

	/**
	 * Uzsakymai su zyma senesne nei $cutoff ir BE post_purchase_2d job'o.
	 * Palaiko ir HPOS, ir senaji postmeta modeli.
	 */
	protected static function find_stamped_before( $cutoff, $limit ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$EJ = $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_email_jobs';

		$hpos = $wpdb->prefix . 'wc_orders_meta';
		$has_hpos = ( $wpdb->get_var( "SHOW TABLES LIKE '$hpos'" ) === $hpos );

		if ( $has_hpos ) {
			$rows = $wpdb->get_col( $wpdb->prepare(
				"SELECT m.order_id
				   FROM $hpos m
				  WHERE m.meta_key = %s AND m.meta_value <= %s
				    AND NOT EXISTS (
				        SELECT 1 FROM $EJ j
				         WHERE j.flow = 'post_purchase_2d'
				           AND j.job_key = CONCAT('post_purchase_2d:', m.order_id) )
				  ORDER BY m.meta_value ASC LIMIT %d",
				self::META_COMPLETED, $cutoff, (int) $limit ) );
			if ( $rows ) { return array_map( 'intval', $rows ); }
		}

		$rows = $wpdb->get_col( $wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT pm.post_id
			   FROM {$wpdb->postmeta} pm
			  WHERE pm.meta_key = %s AND pm.meta_value <= %s
			    AND NOT EXISTS (
			        SELECT 1 FROM $EJ j
			         WHERE j.flow = 'post_purchase_2d'
			           AND j.job_key = CONCAT('post_purchase_2d:', pm.post_id) )
			  ORDER BY pm.meta_value ASC LIMIT %d",
			self::META_COMPLETED, $cutoff, (int) $limit ) );
		return array_map( 'intval', (array) $rows );
	}

	public static function cron_run() {
		self::detect_2d( false );
	}

	public static function stats() {
		global $wpdb;
		$EJ = $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_email_jobs';
		return array(
			'by_status' => $wpdb->get_results(
				"SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM $EJ WHERE flow='post_purchase_2d' GROUP BY status", ARRAY_A ),
		);
	}
}
